review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Network Engineer – Shape the Network Services Behind the Nordics Would you like your engineering work to reach far beyond a single platform or customer? At GlobalConnect, you’ll help shape network services on infrastructure that carries more than half of Scandinavia’s internet connections — connecting businesses, hospitals and public services. This is an opportunity to combine practical engineering with service design and turn complex network needs into reliable solutions that work on a Nordic scale. Build services that people and businesses rely on every day As our Senior Network Engineer – Underlay & Service Development , you’ll work at the intersection of network engineering, technology and product. Your focus will be to turn service concepts into repeatable, scalable network offerings across our Nordic infrastructure. Your day could start with discussing what a new service needs to offer customers. From there, you might translate those needs into an underlay architecture, define service models and configuration templates, or validate a new setup in the lab. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch. You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. You’ll also contribute throughout the service lifecycle — from technical design and validation to launch, documentation and ongoing improvements. In short, you’ll help turn good network engineering into services that customers can depend on. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and evolving underlay architecture for new and existing network services. Translating service requirements into scalable architectures, service models, configuration templates and APIs. Building automation and OSS integrations using technologies such as Python, Ansible, YANG/NETCONF, gNMI and REST. Running lab validation and pilots, followed by post-launch tuning and service lifecycle work. Working across Product, OSS/BSS, NOC, Security and suppliers to establish service KPIs, acceptance criteria and smooth operational handovers. Join the team behind the Nordics’ digital infrastructure You’ll join a Nordic group of experienced network engineers working with Internet, IP-VPN, L2 and DDoS mitigation services. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of the job, and you’ll have plenty of opportunities to exchange ideas with colleagues in engineering, product and operations. Why GlobalConnect? Our fiber and network infrastructure forms part of the digital foundation of Scandinavia, carrying connections used by organizations ranging from smaller businesses to hospitals, enterprises and public services. That scale creates interesting engineering problems — and room to explore new technologies, improve how services are built and automated, and broaden your knowledge across the Nordics. To Thrive Here, We Think You Need 5+ years of experience in carrier or large-enterprise networking, including practical underlay work supporting telecom services. Deep technical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, MPLS L3VPN/L2VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing and OSPF/IS-IS, plus experience with multi-tenant services, wholesale interconnects or peering. Practical experience connecting networks with OSS/BSS, orchestration platforms or service controllers using technologies such as REST APIs and YANG/NETCONF. Experience with vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Arista is relevant. Fluent in English, fluency in a Scandinavian language is a plus. Based in either Copenhagen, Stockholm, Uppsala, or Oslo, where we have our offices. Ready to help shape what runs underneath the connected Nordics? If you’re motivated by solving substantial technical problems, sharing knowledge and seeing your engineering become reliable services used across society, this could be your next step. At GlobalConnect, you’ll have room to deepen your technical skills while contributing to network infrastructure that matters every day. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. We don’t need a personal letter unless there’s something that requires a special explanation and isn’t covered in your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you. About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Manage Tanium Client deployment at scale across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints using GPO, SCCM, Intune, and script-based methods. Configure Tanium Zone Proxies for DMZ and remote site endpoint connectivity and visibility. Monitor Tanium Server and Module Server health, disk utilization, database performance, and service availability. Manage Tanium Client health across the endpoint fleet — identify and remediate non-reporting, unhealthy, or disconnected endpoints. Configure and maintain Tanium computer groups, management rights, and content set assignments for organized endpoint management. Develop and maintain Tanium saved questions, sensors, and packages for endpoint data collection and targeted actions. Manage Tanium action approvals, deployment targeting, and action history reviews for audit and governance compliance. Assist in developing Tanium Comply benchmark customizations and tailored compliance profiles under senior guidance. Endpoint Onboarding & Client Management Manage end-to-end Tanium Client onboarding for new endpoints, sites, and organizational units. Coordinate endpoint onboarding activities with infrastructure, desktop, and server teams to ensure full platform coverage. Validate client registration, sensor data accuracy, and module functionality for newly onboarded endpoints. Manage client configuration files, tanium-init.dat distribution, and client version standardization across the fleet. Support decommissioning and offboarding of endpoints from the Tanium platform following defined procedures. Track onboarding progress and report endpoint coverage metrics to senior engineers and management. Scripting & Automation Develop PowerShell and Batch scripts to automate Tanium Client deployment, health checks, and remediation tasks. Create Tanium packages and action scripts for remote automated fixes, software installations, and configuration changes. Write Tanium Relevance-based sensors for custom endpoint data collection and targeted group scoping. Assist in developing Tanium REST API integrations for reporting automation and ITSM ticket workflows under senior guidance. Maintain a library of tested Tanium packages, scripts, and deployment runbooks for team reuse. Secondary Platform Support Working knowledge of SCCM / Microsoft Intune for hybrid endpoint environments where Tanium coexists with Microsoft tooling. Support Tanium Client deployment leveraging SCCM and Intune as distribution mechanisms for managed endpoints. Assist in troubleshooting endpoint management conflicts between Tanium and co-existing SCCM/Intune tooling. Collaboration & Service Excellence Collaborate with infrastructure, security, desktop, and server teams to support Tanium deployment and operational activities. Participate in change management processes for all Tanium platform configuration changes and deployments. Contribute to Tanium knowledge base articles, deployment SOPs, and operational runbooks. Support audit and compliance activities by providing Tanium platform configuration documentation and endpoint coverage reports. About HabotConnect FZCO HabotConnect FZCO is a Dubai-based, bootstrapped, 100% remote company building a digital platform that connects parents with Learning Support Assistants (LSA)  for children with learning difficulties. We operate in a high-ownership, accountability-driven remote culture where quality and clarity come before speed. About the Role  As our Junior Cloud & Software Associate, you will support the stability, deployment, and security of our cloud platform and applications. This is an entry-level position where you will work directly with our deconstructed logic workflows and automated systems. You will be responsible for translating defined technical specifications into reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud resources, ensuring zero deviation from our operational "Golden Rules”. Primary Responsibilities Infrastructure Management: Provision, configure, and manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) projects, App Engine, and compute resources using Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Application Deployment: Deploy code updates for React frontends and Django REST Framework (DRF) backend services using automated CI/CD pipelines Deployment Quality Control : Implement Poka-Yoke (mistake-proofing) automated linter checks and build gates within deployment pipelines to prevent and block non-compliant code Database Administration: Set up and manage Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) databases with strict schema constraints and integrate Redis / Memorystore for caching Data Pipeline Alignment: Align transactional database models and application logs with Cloud Pub/Sub and BigQuery streaming sinks Data Protection & DR: Implement backup and recovery solutions, maintain storage snapshots, and ensure high-availability redundancy across cloud layers Identity & Access Control: Configure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) manage VPC firewalls and build secure JSON Web Token (JWT) and biometric authentication handshakes between services. Mobile App Release Management: Manage deployments, version control, and release configurations for mobile applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Resource Optimization: Monitor cloud usage, track billing parameters, and continuously optimize resources to minimize platform infrastructure costs. Technical Skills / Tools Cloud Platform: Hands-on familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google App Engine (GAE), Cloud Storage, and BigQuery. Infrastructure-as-Code: Basic understanding of Terraform IaC for resource provisioning. Languages & Frameworks: Proficiency in Python (Django REST Framework) and React. Databases & Caching: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL) and Redis caching. CI/CD & Linting: Familiarity with automated build pipelines and Poka-Yoke deployment validation rules. Mobile Deployment: Basic understanding of distributing applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Cloud Security: Basic knowledge of Identity & Access Management (IAM), VPC networking, and JWT authentication. Soft Skills & Remote Work Mindset: Self-Discipline & Routine: Exceptional time-management skills with the ability to maintain a highly productive and consistent remote routine Meticulous Attention to Detail: Extreme structural discipline and a commitment to validating work thoroughly rather than assuming correctness Resourcefulness: An independent learner who proactively utilizes documentation and outside resources to solve technical blocks Structured Communication: Ability to communicate clearly, objectively, and concisely via chat and email Onboarding & Success Path Selected candidates must successfully complete a mandatory structured onboarding and training program. Engagement and progress during onboarding are closely monitored and form part of the probation evaluation. Failure to complete required training or demonstrate sufficient involvement may result in the offer being withdrawn. What This Role Is NOT This is NOT a senior architect, lead engineer, or tech lead position. It is an entry-level, execution-focused role where you will deploy and maintain resources based on structured guidelines This is NOT a subjective, open-ended decision-making role. We build highly automated, strict, rule-based systems to eliminate guesswork This is NOT a part-time or flexible freelance contract. It is a full-time, high-ownership commitment Application Process  Interested candidates are invited to apply for this exciting opportunity. As part of our evaluation process, you will be required to complete a short Hiring Project Form (HPF)  simulating the analytical tasks of this role. Project Link: https://forms.gle/QtepbWte3C9rAv2G6 Kindly review the project instructions carefully and submit your completed work using the submission link below. Be sure to include your contact information and any other required details. Submission Link (Google Form): https://forms.gle/qaTCAxi3YA8MCN196 Submission Deadline: 13-September-2026 Our team will review all submissions, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a virtual interview. Note: You only have one chance to submit. We are looking for quality of identification and clarity of impact. Final Self-Screening Checklist Apply only if: You are comfortable with the exact salary bracket of 18,000 - 21,000 INR/month. You have a dedicated workspace with a stable internet connection and webcam for remote work. You are fully prepared to abandon traditional workflow writing and embrace strict Data Flow logic.

Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems. This role is ideal for a finance professional with a strong analytical foundation, deep experience in capital-intensive environments, and the ability to operate independently across a broad scope — from JV-level financial reporting and variance analysis to forecasting, budgeting, and cross-functional business partnering. This is a high-visibility, individual-contributor role with direct exposure to senior leadership and a meaningful opportunity to shape how FP&A supports the reporting requirements of a complex, joint-venture-structured development project. The right candidate brings intellectual curiosity about data center and project finance economics, a bias toward action, and the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, decision-ready insights. This is an experienced senior hire, not an entry point into FP&A. Prepare project-level and facility-level P&L reporting, including monthly variance analysis, commentary, and distribution to project leadership and the joint venture partner. Support preparation of periodic compliance certificates, financial statements, and other lender- or investor-required deliverables in coordination with Accounting, Treasury, and Corporate Development. Track and reconcile capital contributions, capital accounts, and incentive/promote calculations against the joint venture's return waterfall mechanics. Build and maintain driver-based forecasting models for the project, incorporating construction draw schedules, phased delivery timing, and stabilization assumptions across the development lifecycle. Own preparation of the annual business plan and budget for the project, coordinating inputs with Project Delivery, Operations, and the joint venture partner's asset management team. Monitor actual development costs versus budget, flagging variances and escalating items with a material cost or return impact. Partner with Accounting to ensure accurate treatment of the joint venture's legal entity structure in corporate consolidation, distinguishing consolidation versus equity-method accounting where applicable. Apply and maintain the corporate cost allocation methodology used to determine shared costs attributable to the joint venture, ensuring allocations are well-documented and defensible. Reconcile general ledger data to joint venture and lender reporting outputs, identifying and resolving discrepancies in partnership with Accounting. Serve as the embedded FP&A point of contact for the project, working cross-functionally with Legal, Accounting, Treasury, and Development to support reporting, budgeting, and ad hoc partner requests. Support ad hoc financial analysis and business case development as assigned, including cost-benefit analysis, valuation support, and scenario modeling. Identify and flag data quality issues in source systems and reporting outputs, documenting discrepancies with clear recommendations and following through on resolution with Accounting. Contribute to the documentation of joint venture reporting processes, templates, and standards as this workstream matures. Specific Skills/Abilities Advanced Excel proficiency including financial modeling, lookup functions (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), pivot tables, and multi-source data consolidation; Power Query experience strongly preferred. Working knowledge of private equity / joint venture structures — capital contributions, preferred return and profit-split waterfalls, capital account mechanics, and incentive/promote calculations. Comfort translating dense legal and partnership agreement language into repeatable, well-documented finance processes and reporting calendars. Strong understanding of GAAP accounting principles — including accruals, prepaids, depreciation, capitalization policy, and CapEx vs. OpEx classification — with demonstrated ability to apply these concepts in an FP&A context. Ability to manage external-facing, contractually-driven reporting deadlines with precision, escalating risks to timely delivery well in advance. Strong analytical and communication skills — able to synthesize complex, multi-entity financial data into clear, concise variance commentary and executive-ready reporting. Ability to manage multiple workstreams independently, prioritize effectively under tight deadlines, and escalate issues with clear documentation. Intellectually curious about business operations — able to engage meaningfully with non-finance stakeholders and translate operational realities into financial assumptions. Skills And Requirements Direct experience in capital-intensive industries — data centers, real estate, energy, infrastructure, or project-based environments — strongly preferred; data center finance experience is a meaningful differentiator. Prior exposure to joint venture, fund, or PE-backed reporting obligations (capital call/distribution tracking, compliance certificates, investor/quarterly reporting) is a meaningful differentiator. Demonstrated ownership of a full reporting cycle: close, variance analysis, commentary, and distribution. Experience building or maintaining project-level, property-level, or site-level P&L models preferred. Prior experience owning a budget or forecasting process for one or more cost centers, not just supporting it. Proficiency with ERP or financial reporting systems; NetSuite experience a plus. Education/Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate Finance, or related field. 5–7+ years of FP&A, financial analysis, project/real estate finance, or relevant accounting experience — this is an experienced senior hire, not an entry point into FP&A. Experience at a PE-backed, joint-venture-structured, or high-growth company a plus. EEO Statement Edged is an equal opportunities employer. We assess candidate qualifications and make recruiting decisions based on the experience, capabilities and skills you share with us in your application and applicable materials. Hiring and employment decisions within Edged are not based on religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Total Rewards Statement This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; PTO; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, location, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Great Place to Work Enjoy… A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation. A flexible, autonomous work environment. A culture of respect, learning, and excellence. Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers. Growth and travel opportunities. A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet. Contact : edcrecruiting@edged.us
